record.field: المخالفات الحكومية: تحديث نوافذ الاعتراض والتذكيرات

today = datetime.date.today() V = env['x_gov_violation'].with_context(active_test=False, tracking_disable=True) stale = V.search([('x_objection_state', '=', 'open'), ('x_objection_deadline', '<', today)]) stale |= V.search([('x_date_warning', '=', True)]) if stale: stale.write({'x_refresh_stamp': datetime.datetime.now()}) try: days = int(env['ir.config_parameter'].sudo().get_param('x_gov_violations.reminder_days', '7')) except ValueError: days = 7 if days > 0: due = V.search([ ('x_active', '=', True), ('x_status', '=', 'unpaid'), ('x_objection_state', '=', 'open'), ('x_objection_deadline', '!=', False), ('x_objection_deadline', '<=', today + datetime.timedelta(days=days)), ('x_reminder_sent', '=', False), ('x_user_id', '!=', False), ]) for record in due: record.activity_schedule( 'x_gov_violations.mail_activity_type_objection_deadline', date_deadline=record.x_objection_deadline, summary='موعد الاعتراض يقترب', note='آخر موعد للاعتراض على المخالفة %s هو %s' % (record.x_name, record.x_objection_deadline), user_id=record.x_user_id.id, ) due.write({'x_reminder_sent': True})
